claims.text: Machine learning-based modeling can predict the high-temperature oxidation behavior of high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning-based modeling can predict the phase stability of high-entropy alloys.
Machine learning can capture complex relationships involving alloy composition.
Machine learning can capture complex relationships involving alloy microstructure.
Machine learning can capture complex relationships involving alloy processing conditions.
Capturing relationships among composition, microstructure, and processing conditions enables accurate prediction of high-temperature oxidation behavior.
Capturing relationships among composition, microstructure, and processing conditions enables accurate prediction of phase stability.
Machine learning-based modeling will improve prediction of high-temperature oxidation behavior relative to current experimental methods and computational models.
Machine learning-based modeling will improve prediction of phase stability relative to current experimental methods and computational models.
The applicability of the modeling approach is limited by the availability of training data.
The applicability of the modeling approach is limited by the quality of training data.
The applicability of the modeling approach is limited by the complexity of the alloy systems.
Prediction accuracy and reliability are especially uncertain for new and untested alloy compositions.
